description:
Yep, only 4 ingredient vanilla ice cream. It is super quick and easy to make and tastes delicious.

350g Milk 2% (1.5cups)
350g Cream 33% (1.5 cups)
400g Condensed Milk (1 can/10 Oz)
1 Vanilla Bean/15g Vanilla Extract/15g Vanilla Bean Paste

Mix it all together and churn away, it really is that easy. If you want to use a vanille bean, I would gently heat the milk with the sliced vanilla bean, making sure to add the vanilla bean seed to the milk too. Let it sit for an hour on the lowest heat and then add the rest of the ingredients. 

Churny churny and enjoy!!

Made this base up last night and froze to spin in the Ninja Creami deluxe today. Followed the recipe in terms of measurements, but only had whole milk and double cream, but combined with a tin of condensed milk and 15g of Neilsen Massey vanilla extract, I mixed it and froze. 

When i took it out earlier today, this was the first mix that hadn't 'peaked' in the freezer like most Ninja recipes do. So I spun it on the Ice Cream setting, but it seemed quite soft, softer than expecting and I thought maybe the slightly different milk and cream had affected it. So had a taste... very nice, very smooth, and put it back in the freezer. Have just checked it and its firmed up, but is definitely scoopable, something none of my previous attempts were, and always needed a respin.
